  "notes": "WHY THIS IS A STOP AND NOT A WIDENING. S10B-AC0 reserves the re-cut to the issuer in terms, so nothing was taught, built, or deployed. TO-OP-S-10 read two FUNCTIONS and the capability sat on the ROLES beneath them -- that was Z-S105's correction. THE INSTRUMENT LESSON WORTH KEEPING: the two planes disagreed on exactly one member and that disagreement is the whole value of running both. A source census alone calls opal-session-analytics a consumer with no evidence it ever runs; a CloudTrail census alone omits it entirely and would have shipped a three-consumer answer that looked measured. THE REUSABLE PART: a shared keyed store makes 'what is true of X' expressible and 'who says so, and why' inexpressible -- and every multi-writer design eventually needs the second.
